posts.zh:
dsh-web-startup-auth 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。替换 dsh web 启动器以允许绑定 0.0.0.0，并以账号密码登录为门槛：签名会话 cookie、/api 路由保护、设置面板认证标签页，以及轮换签名密钥使全部会话失效的重置 CLI。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-80896ac4a1fbaf970572.html
posts.en:
dsh-web-startup-auth is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Replaces the dsh web startup to allow binding 0.0.0.0, gated by username/password login: signed session cookies, /api route protection, an auth tab in the settings panel, and a reset CLI that rotates the signing key to invalidate all sessions.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-80896ac4a1fbaf970572.html
